-历史背景-

column2: July 10th of 1943, the 7th US Army in command of General Patton and 8th British Army in charge of General Montgomery, iniciate the invasion to Sicily Island, when, on January 1943, the Allied Joint Major State Chiefs take the decision to invade Italy.
column3: 1943年7月10日，由 Patton 将军指挥的美国第7集团军和由 Montgomery 将军统率的英国第8集团军发起对西西里岛(Sicily Island)的入侵，而早在1943年1月，盟军联合参谋长会议就做出了入侵意大利的决定。
他们计划了三个目标：
- 打通地中海的海上航线
- 从俄国前线牵走兵力。

column2: - Push pression on Italy, trying to get it out of fight
column3: - 对意大利施压，试图让它退出战争

column2: Allies expected and quick and easy victory, but instead it was a hard campaign that will last until the end of war.
column3: 盟军本以为会是一场迅速而轻松的胜利，结果却是一场一直打到战争结束的苦战。

column2: The difficult terrain, the great and determined German's defense and the Allies's lack of iniciative, helped the to make a long term campaign.
column3: 艰难的地形、德军出色而坚决的防御，以及盟军缺乏主动，使这场战役变成了持久战。
